key.name: font-family
key.summary: Terminal font family
key.description: Pango font family name used by the integrated terminal.

key.name: font-size
key.summary: Terminal font size
key.description: Font size in points used by the integrated terminal.

key.name: cursor-shape
key.summary: Cursor shape
key.description: 0 = block, 1 = underline, 2 = I-beam.

key.name: cursor-blink-mode
key.summary: Cursor blink mode
key.description: 0 = follow system setting, 1 = always blink, 2 = never blink.

key.name: solarized
key.summary: Use the Solarized color scheme
key.description: If true, the Solarized palette and default colors are used instead of the standard scheme.

key.name: palette-customized
key.summary: Whether the 16-color palette was edited by hand
key.description: If true, "palette" below overrides the scheme's built-in palette.

key.name: palette
key.summary: Custom 16-color palette
key.description: 16 colors as hex strings (#rrggbb), only used when palette-customized is true.

key.name: use-system-colors
key.summary: Use GTK theme colors
key.description: If true, default foreground/background are read from the active GTK theme instead of the scheme or custom default colors.

key.name: bold-is-bright
key.summary: Show bold text in bright colors

key.name: custom-default-colors-enabled
key.summary: Whether a custom default foreground/background color is set

key.name: custom-default-fg
key.summary: Custom default foreground color (hex)

key.name: custom-default-bg
key.summary: Custom default background color (hex)

key.name: custom-bold-color-enabled
key.summary: Whether a custom bold text color is set

key.name: custom-bold-color
key.summary: Custom bold text color (hex)

key.name: custom-cursor-colors-enabled
key.summary: Whether custom cursor colors are set

key.name: custom-cursor-fg
key.summary: Custom cursor text color (hex)

key.name: custom-cursor-bg
key.summary: Custom cursor shape color (hex)

key.name: custom-highlight-colors-enabled
key.summary: Whether custom selection colors are set

key.name: custom-highlight-fg
key.summary: Custom selection text color (hex)

key.name: custom-highlight-bg
key.summary: Custom selection background color (hex)

key.name: backspace-binding
key.summary: Backspace key binding
key.description: 0=auto, 1=ASCII backspace, 2=ASCII delete, 3=escape sequence, 4=tty.

key.name: delete-binding
key.summary: Delete key binding
key.description: 0=auto, 1=ASCII backspace, 2=ASCII delete, 3=escape sequence, 4=tty.

key.name: ambiguous-width-wide
key.summary: Treat CJK-ambiguous-width characters as wide

key.name: cell-width-scale
key.summary: Cell width scale

key.name: cell-height-scale
key.summary: Cell height scale

key.name: scrollback-lines
key.summary: Scrollback line limit

key.name: scroll-on-output
key.summary: Scroll to bottom on output

key.name: scroll-on-keystroke
key.summary: Scroll to bottom on keystroke

key.name: scroll-on-paste
key.summary: Scroll to bottom on paste

key.name: show-scrollbar
key.summary: Show the terminal scrollbar

key.name: login-shell
key.summary: Run the shell as a login shell

key.name: use-custom-command
key.summary: Run a custom command instead of the shell

key.name: custom-command
key.summary: Custom command to run

key.name: text-blink-enabled
key.summary: Allow blinking text (SGR 5/25)

key.name: bell-enabled
key.summary: Enable the audible terminal bell

key.name: follow-location
key.summary: Follow the file manager's current folder

key.name: exit-action
key.summary: Action to take when the command exits
key.description: 0 = hold (keep last screen contents), 1 = restart the command.

key.name: initial-columns
key.summary: Initial terminal column count

key.name: initial-rows
key.summary: Initial terminal row count

key.name: menubar-default-visible
key.summary: Show the menu bar in new terminals by default

key.name: menu-mnemonics-enabled
key.summary: Enable menu mnemonic letters (e.g. Alt+F for File)

key.name: menu-accel-enabled
key.summary: Enable the menu accelerator key (default: F10)

key.name: check-default-terminal
key.summary: Always check whether this is the default terminal application

key.name: keybindings-enabled
key.summary: Enable terminal keyboard shortcuts

key.name: gid-projects
key.summary: Local GID project folders
key.description: Absolute paths of the local project folders shown in the "GID-Projekte" section of the side pane. Removing an entry never deletes files.

key.name: preview-enabled
key.summary: Enable file previews in the info panel
key.description: If set to false, the F11 info panel shows metadata only, without attempting to load an image preview.

key.name: preview-max-file-size
key.summary: Maximum file size for previews, in bytes
key.description: Files larger than this are shown with a generic icon instead of a decoded preview, to avoid a slow synchronous decode. Default is 100 MB.

key.name: tabs-open-position
key.summary: Where to position newly open tabs in browser windows.
key.description: If set to "after-current-tab", then new tabs are inserted after the current tab. If set to "end", then new tabs are appended to the end of the tab list.

key.name: always-use-browser
key.summary: Enables the classic Nolphin behavior, where all windows are browsers
key.description: If set to true, then all Nolphin windows will be browser windows. This is how Nolphin used to behave before version 2.6, and some people prefer this behavior.

key.name: quick-renames-with-pause-in-between
key.summary: Enables renaming of icons by two times clicking with pause between clicks
key.description: If set to true, then icons in all Nolphin windows will be able to get renamed quickly. Users should click two times on icons with a pause time more than double-click time of their system.

key.name: expand-row-on-dnd-dwell
key.summary: During drag-and-drop operations, automatically expand rows when hovering them briefly

key.name: show-location-entry
key.summary: Show the location entry by default
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show a textual input entry for the location toolbar.

key.name: show-previous-icon-toolbar
key.summary: Show Previous button in nolphin toolbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-next-icon-toolbar
key.summary: Show Next button in nolphin toolbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-up-icon-toolbar
key.summary: Show Up button in nolphin toolbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-reload-icon-toolbar
key.summary: Show refresh button in nolphin toolbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-edit-icon-toolbar
key.summary: Show toggle button location entry/pathbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-home-icon-toolbar
key.summary: Show Home button in nolphin toolbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-computer-icon-toolbar
key.summary: Show Computer button in nolphin toolbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-search-icon-toolbar
key.summary: Show Search button in nolphin toolbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-new-folder-icon-toolbar
key.summary: Show new folder button in nolphin toolbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-open-in-terminal-toolbar
key.summary: Show open in terminal in the nolphin toolbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-icon-view-icon-toolbar
key.summary: Show Icon View button in nolphin toolbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-list-view-icon-toolbar
key.summary: Show List View button in nolphin toolbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-compact-view-icon-toolbar
key.summary: Show Compact View button in nolphin toolbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-show-thumbnails-toolbar
key.summary: Show Thumbnails button in nolphin toolbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-toggle-extra-pane-toolbar
key.summary: Show Extra Pane button in nolphin toolbar
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin browser windows will show the button.

key.name: show-root-warning
key.summary: Show warning when opening as root
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin show warning message when run Nolphin as root user.

key.name: confirm-move-to-trash
key.summary: Whether to ask for confirmation when moving files to Trash
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin will ask for confirmation when you attempt to move files to the Trash.

key.name: confirm-trash
key.summary: Whether to ask for confirmation when deleting files, or emptying Trash
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin will ask for confirmation when you attempt to delete files, or empty the Trash.

key.name: enable-delete
key.summary: Whether to enable immediate deletion
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin will have a feature allowing you to delete a file immediately and in-place, instead of moving it to the trash. This feature can be dangerous, so use caution.

key.name: swap-trash-delete
key.summary: Whether to swap the hotkeys for Trash and Delete
key.description: If set to true, the Delete key will permanently delete a file, and the Shift-Delete key will only trash a file.

key.name: trash-retention-days
key.summary: Automatic Trash retention period in days
key.description: Items in Trash older than this many days (based on trash::deletion-date) are permanently deleted automatically. 0 disables automatic cleanup.

key.name: trash-size-limit-mb
key.summary: Trash size limit in megabytes for the warning notification
key.description: When the total size of Trash exceeds this many megabytes, Nolphin shows a warning notification. 0 disables the warning.

key.name: show-directory-item-counts
key.summary: When to show number of items in a folder
key.description: Speed tradeoff for when to show the number of items in a folder. If set to "always" then always show item counts, even if the folder is on a remote server. If set to "local-only" then only show counts for local file systems. If set to "never" then never bother to compute item counts.

key.name: click-policy
key.summary: Type of click used to launch/open files
key.description: Possible values are "single" to launch files on a single click, or "double" to launch them on a double click.

key.name: executable-text-activation
key.summary: What to do with executable text files when activated
key.description: What to do with executable text files when they are activated (single or double clicked). Possible values are "launch" to launch them as programs, "ask" to ask what to do via a dialog, and "display" to display them as text files.

key.name: image-viewers-with-external-sort
key.summary: Image viewer executables to pass sort order to
key.description: When opening a single image with an application in this list, allow that viewer to display other images in the current nolphin view, in the presented order (including searches). Other image viewers can be added, but are likely to ignore the order. The viewer Exec line must accept a list of files (either %U or %F).

key.name: mouse-use-extra-buttons
key.summary: Use extra mouse button events in Nolphin' browser window
key.description: For users with mice that have "Forward" and "Back" buttons, this key will determine if any action is taken inside of Nolphin when either is pressed.

key.name: mouse-forward-button
key.summary: Mouse button to activate the "Forward" command in browser window
key.description: For users with mice that have buttons for "Forward" and "Back", this key will set which button activates the "Forward" command in a browser window. Possible values range between 6 and 14.

key.name: mouse-back-button
key.summary: Mouse button to activate the "Back" command in browser window
key.description: For users with mice that have buttons for "Forward" and "Back", this key will set which button activates the "Back" command in a browser window. Possible values range between 6 and 14.

key.name: show-image-thumbnails
key.summary: When to show thumbnails of image files
key.description: Speed tradeoff for when to show an image file as a thumbnail. If set to "always" then always thumbnail, even if the folder is on a remote server. If set to "local-only" then only show thumbnails for local file systems. If set to "never" then never bother to thumbnail images, just use a generic icon.

key.name: inherit-show-thumbnails
key.summary: Inherit thumbnail visibility from parent
key.description: If set, folders will inherit their thumbnail visibility from their parents

key.name: thumbnail-limit
key.summary: Maximum image size for thumbnailing
key.description: Images over this size (in bytes) won't be thumbnailed. The purpose of this setting is to avoid thumbnailing large images that may take a long time to load or use lots of memory.

key.name: show-advanced-permissions
key.summary: Show advanced permissions in the file property dialog
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin lets you edit and display file permissions in a more unix-like way, accessing some more esoteric options.

key.name: sort-directories-first
key.summary: Show folders first in windows
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin shows folders prior to showing files in the icon and list views.

key.name: sort-favorites-first
key.summary: Show favorites first in windows
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin shows favorites prior to other files in the icon and list views.

key.name: default-sort-order
key.summary: Default sort order
key.description: The default sort-order for items in the icon view. Possible values are "name", "size", "type" and "mtime".

key.name: default-sort-in-reverse-order
key.summary: Reverse sort order in new windows
key.description: If true, files in new windows will be sorted in reverse order. ie, if sorted by name, then instead of sorting the files from "a" to "z", they will be sorted from "z" to "a"; if sorted by size, instead of being incrementally they will be sorted decrementally.

key.name: desktop-is-home-dir
key.summary: Nolphin uses the users home folder as the desktop
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin will use the user's home folder as the desktop. If it is false, then it will use ~/Desktop as the desktop.

key.name: default-folder-viewer
key.summary: Default folder viewer
key.description: When a folder is visited this viewer is used unless you have selected another view for that particular folder. Possible values are "list-view", "icon-view" and "compact-view".

key.name: inherit-folder-viewer
key.summary: Inherit the view type (icon, compact, list) from parent to children
key.description: When a folder is visited the viewer is inherited from that folder's parent unless you have selected another view for that particular folder.

key.name: date-format
key.summary: Date Format
key.description: The format of file dates. Possible values are "locale", "iso", and "informal".

key.name: date-font-choice
key.summary: The font to use for the date/time columns.
key.description: The format of file dates. Possible values are "auto-mono" (best effort to match the application font), "system-mono" (use the current system mono font), and "no-mono" (use a normal font).

key.name: show-hidden-files
key.summary: Whether to show hidden files
key.description: If set to true, then hidden files are shown by default in the file manager. Hidden files are either dotfiles, listed in the folder's .hidden file or backup files ending with a tilde (~).

key.name: show-full-path-titles
key.summary: Whether to show the full path of the current view in the title bar and tab bars
key.description: If set to true, will show the normal title of a window or tab, followed by the full path to that location in parentheses.

key.name: bulk-rename-tool
key.summary: Bulk rename utility
key.description: If set, Nolphin will append URIs of selected files and treat the result as a command line for bulk renaming. Bulk rename applications can register themselves in this key by setting the key to a space-separated string of their executable name and any command line options. If the executable name is not set to a full path, it will be searched for in the search path.

key.name: size-prefixes
key.summary: Prefixes used for file sizes
key.description: Determines whether Nolphin uses base-10, base-10 long, base-2 or base-2 long file size prefixes

key.name: close-device-view-on-device-eject
key.summary: Whether to close a view of a removeable device instead of navigating Home
key.description: If set to true, a view open for a removeable device will be closed instead of sent Home if the device is ejected

key.name: start-with-dual-pane
key.summary: Whether to default to showing dual-pane view when a new window is opened
key.description: If set to true, new Nolphin windows will default to showing two panes

key.name: restore-tabs-on-startup
key.summary: Restore the previous window tabs on startup
key.description: If set to true, Nolphin will restore the last saved window tab state when launched without explicit locations.

key.name: ignore-view-metadata
key.summary: Whether to ignore folder metadata for view zoom levels and layouts
key.description: If set to true, views will not change according to their metadata, but stay consistent for the life of that window

key.name: show-bookmarks-in-to-menus
key.summary: Whether to list bookmarks in the Move To/Copy To menus
key.description: If set to true, bookmarks will be listed in the MoveTo/CopyTo menus

key.name: show-places-in-to-menus
key.summary: Whether to list places in the Move To/Copy To menus
key.description: If set to true, places will be listed in the MoveTo/CopyTo menus

key.name: context-menus-show-all-actions
key.summary: deprecated - no longer used

key.name: tooltips-on-desktop
key.summary: Show tooltips for desktop items
key.description: If true, tooltips will be displayed for desktop items.

key.name: tooltips-in-icon-view
key.summary: Show tooltips when hovering on items in an icon or compact view
key.description: If true, tooltips will be displayed for icon and compact view items

key.name: tooltips-in-list-view
key.summary: Show tooltips when hovering on items in a list view
key.description: If true, tooltips will be displayed for list view items

key.name: tooltips-show-file-type
key.summary: Show detailed file type in tooltip
key.description: If true, tooltips will show a detailed file type.

key.name: tooltips-show-mod-date
key.summary: Show file modified date in tooltip
key.description: If true, tooltips will show their modified date.

key.name: tooltips-show-access-date
key.summary: Show file accessed date in tooltip
key.description: If true, tooltips will show their accessed date.

key.name: tooltips-show-birth-date
key.summary: Show file creation (birth) date in tooltip
key.description: If true, tooltips will show their creation date.

key.name: tooltips-show-path
key.summary: Show full path in tooltip
key.description: If true, tooltips will show the file's full path.

key.name: disable-menu-warning
key.summary: Don't show the explainer message when turning off the main menu
key.description: If true, you will no longer recieve a popup explaining how to reactivate the main menu once you've hidden it

key.name: last-server-connect-method
key.summary: Last server connect method used

key.name: never-queue-file-ops
key.summary: If true, all file operations will start immediately

key.name: click-double-parent-folder
key.summary: If true, double click left on blank area will go to parent folder

key.name: enable-mime-actions-make-executable
key.summary: Display the 'Make executable and run' button in the mime-action dialog (open an unknown filetype)

key.name: deferred-attribute-preload-limit
key.summary: Maximum number of files to preload deferred attributes for when opening a directory
key.description: Certain file attributes (like thumbnail and extension info) are deferred until a folder finishes loading. This number specifies how many files to skip this behavior on so that smaller folders won't have an obvious delay when loading these attributes.

key.name: treat-root-as-normal
key.summary: Suppress any safeguards when running nolphin/nolphin-desktop as the root user. For some systems there is only a root user.

key.name: detect-content
key.summary: If true, enable detection of the type of content of a mounted media and display a suggested application to open the media.

key.name: thumbnail-threads
key.summary: Number of threads to dedicate to thumbnailing. -1 to let the program decide. The maximum allowed threads is half the number of logical processors, regardless of what is set here. If you change this setting you must restart Nolphin for it to take effect.

key.name: captions
key.summary: List of possible captions on icons
key.description: A list of captions below an icon in the icon view and the desktop. The actual number of captions shown depends on the zoom level. Some possible values are: "size", "type", "date_modified", "date_changed", "date_accessed", "owner", "group", "permissions", "octal_permissions" and "mime_type".

key.name: default-use-tighter-layout
key.summary: deprecated - not used

key.name: labels-beside-icons
key.summary: Put labels beside icons
key.description: If true, labels will be placed beside icons rather than underneath them.

key.name: default-zoom-level
key.summary: Default icon zoom level
key.description: Default zoom level used by the icon view.

key.name: thumbnail-size
key.summary: Default Thumbnail Icon Size
key.description: The default size of an icon for a thumbnail in the icon view.

key.name: text-ellipsis-limit
key.summary: Text Ellipsis Limit
key.description:
A string specifying how parts of overlong file names should be replaced by ellipses, depending on the zoom level. Each of the list entries is of the form "Zoom Level:Integer". For each specified zoom level, if the given integer is larger than 0, the file name will not exceed the given number of lines. If the integer is 0 or smaller, no limit is imposed on the specified zoom level. A default entry of the form "Integer" without any specified zoom level is also allowed. It defines the maximum number of lines for all other zoom levels. Examples: 0 - always display overlong file names; 3 - shorten file names if they exceed three lines; smallest:5,smaller:4,0 - shorten file names if they exceed five lines for zoom level "smallest". Shorten file names if they exceed four lines for zoom level "smaller". Do not shorten file names for other zoom levels.
Available zoom levels: smallest (33%), smaller (50%), small (66%), standard (100%), large (150%), larger (200%), largest (400%)

key.name: default-zoom-level
key.summary: Default compact view zoom level
key.description: Default zoom level used by the compact view.

key.name: all-columns-have-same-width
key.summary: All columns have same width
key.description: If this preference is set, all columns in the compact view have the same width. Otherwise, the width of each column is determined seperately.

key.name: default-zoom-level
key.summary: Default list zoom level
key.description: Default zoom level used by the list view.

key.name: default-visible-columns
key.summary: Default list of columns visible in the list view
key.description: Default list of columns visible in the list view.

key.name: default-column-order
key.summary: Default column order in the list view
key.description: Default column order in the list view.

key.name: enable-folder-expansion
key.summary: If true, allow folders with content to be expanded in the current view.

key.name: show-only-directories
key.summary: Only show folders in the tree side pane
key.description: If set to true, Nolphin will only show folders in the tree side pane. Otherwise it will show both folders and files.

key.name: font
key.summary: Desktop font
key.description: The font description used for the icons on the desktop.

key.name: desktop-layout
key.summary: Desktop layout
key.description: Format bool:bool, show desktop folder on primary monitor:show desktop on remaining monitors

key.name: show-orphaned-desktop-icons
key.summary: Whether to show icons from inactive monitors on another monitor

key.name: show-desktop-icons
key.summary: Deprecated: Allow Nolphin to manage the desktop
key.description: Deprecated: If this is set to true, Nolphin will autostart and manage the desktop

key.name: use-desktop-grid
key.summary: Which desktop view type to use
key.description: If true, the new desktop grid view will be used by nolphin-desktop, otherwise the legacy view will be used.

key.name: vertical-grid-adjust
key.summary: Vertical desktop grid adjustment
key.description: Overrides the standard vertical spacing for the desktop grid, in situation where default spacing is not ideal due to label customizations. This is a value from 0.5 to 1.5, with 1.0 being no adjustment, and 0.5 being half the default spacing.

key.name: horizontal-grid-adjust
key.summary: Horizontal desktop grid adjustment
key.description: Overrides the standard horizontal spacing for the desktop grid, in situation where default spacing is not ideal due to label customizations. This is a value from 0.5 to 1.5, with 1.0 being no adjustment, and 0.5 being half the default spacing.

key.name: home-icon-visible
key.summary: Home icon visible on desktop
key.description: If this is set to true, an icon linking to the home folder will be put on the desktop.

key.name: computer-icon-visible
key.summary: Computer icon visible on desktop
key.description: If this is set to true, an icon linking to the computer location will be put on the desktop.

key.name: trash-icon-visible
key.summary: Trash icon visible on desktop
key.description: If this is set to true, an icon linking to the trash will be put on the desktop.

key.name: volumes-visible
key.summary: Show mounted volumes on the desktop
key.description: If this is set to true, icons linking to mounted volumes will be put on the desktop.

key.name: network-icon-visible
key.summary: Network Servers icon visible on the desktop
key.description: If this is set to true, an icon linking to the Network Servers view will be put on the desktop.

key.name: text-ellipsis-limit
key.summary: Text Ellipsis Limit
key.description: An integer specifying how parts of overlong file names should be replaced by ellipses on the desktop. If the number is larger than 0, the file name will not exceed the given number of lines. If the number is 0 or smaller, no limit is imposed on the number of displayed lines.

key.name: ignored-desktop-handlers
key.summary: List of desktop-handling to ignore when determining whether or not to manager the desktop.
key.description: Nolphin checks for _NET_WM_WINDOW_TYPE_DESKTOP-type windows, and skips managing the desktop if any others are detected. Add potential names to this list to ignore when performing this check. This means that you want nolphin to create its own desktop window(s) even though something else already seems to. The check is based on a program's WM_CLASS.

key.name: background-fade
key.summary: Fade the background on change
key.description: If set to true, then Nolphin will use a fade effect to change the desktop background.

key.name: geometry
key.summary: The geometry string for a navigation window.
key.description: A string containing the saved geometry and coordinates string for navigation windows.

key.name: maximized
key.summary: Whether the navigation window should be maximized.
key.description: Whether the navigation window should be maximized by default.

key.name: sidebar-width
key.summary: Width of the side pane
key.description: The default width of the side pane in new windows.

key.name: sidebar-bookmark-breakpoint
key.summary: Index of the bookmark list to jump to the dedicated sidebar bookmark section
key.description: This is an internal setting for the sidebar that tracks the index in the bookmark list that separates bookmarks in the Computer section from bookmarks in the Bookmark section.

key.name: start-with-toolbar
key.summary: Show toolbar in new windows
key.description: If set to true, newly opened windows will have toolbars visible.

key.name: start-with-location-bar
key.summary: Show location bar in new windows
key.description: If set to true, newly opened windows will have the location bar visible.

key.name: start-with-status-bar
key.summary: Show status bar in new windows
key.description: If set to true, newly opened windows will have the status bar visible.

key.name: start-with-sidebar
key.summary: Show side pane in new windows
key.description: If set to true, newly opened windows will have the side pane visible.

key.name: start-with-terminal
key.summary: Show terminal panel in new windows
key.description: If set to true, newly opened windows will have the integrated terminal panel visible.

key.name: terminal-height
key.summary: Height of the terminal panel
key.description: The default height in pixels of the integrated terminal panel.

key.name: show-gid-projects
key.summary: Show the GID projects section in the side pane
key.description: If set to false, the "GID-Projekte" section below the places or tree side pane is hidden.

key.name: start-with-preview
key.summary: Show the info/preview panel in new windows
key.description: If set to true, newly opened windows will have the F11 info/preview panel visible.

key.name: preview-width
